tools.name: ZModeler
tools.role: historical skeleton bind, Compound and XBG export route; replaced by the bundled XBG writer since 2026-10-03

tools.name: XBG writer (pure Python, bundled)
tools.role: template-based char01.xbg writer, skeleton patch, FAT v8 repack and texconv-free XBT encoder; runtime-confirmed by Karin 1.4, 1.5 and Karin_Original 0.1.2

tools.name: Blender
tools.role: source, LOD and FBX authoring (not needed for the VRM direct route)

runtime_boundary: v1.3.0 default outfit acceptance with minor finger limitation; ZModeler-free 1.4/1.5 and Karin_Original 0.1.2 accepted in game (Karin_Original: load, face and eyes only)
python: 3.10+ for the XBT scripts; 3.12+ for the XBG writer (numpy pin)
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt (from bundle root); add -r portable-kits/watch-dogs/requirements.txt for the XBG writer and skeleton tools
